items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: I knew Olga San Juan when she was a baby.

ctx.x: Okay. What else do you remember about Los Angeles? How did Bing Crosby and Nino Remay get into that picture with you?
Well, because Olga San Juan, I knew Olga San Juan when she was a baby.
The Puerto Rican actress that went and made it big in Hollywood.
